provider_trial_slots_request_outcome_aft.name: provider_trial_slots_request_outcome_after_start_check

provider_trial_slots_terminal_outcome_sh.name: provider_trial_slots_terminal_outcome_shape_check

runner_credentials_revoked_status_check.name: runner_credentials_revoked_status_check

runner_registration_tokens_used_status_c.name: runner_registration_tokens_used_status_check

runner_registration_tokens_revoked_statu.name: runner_registration_tokens_revoked_status_check
runner_registration_tokens_revoked_statu.value: ("runner_registration_tokens"."status" = 'revoked' AND "runner_registration_tokens"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("runner_registration_tokens"."status" <> 'revoked' AND "runner_registration_tokens"."revoked_at" IS NULL)

runner_replacements_replacement_window_c.name: runner_replacements_replacement_window_check

runner_replacements_lease_pair_check.name: runner_replacements_lease_pair_check

runner_replacements_terminal_summary_che.name: runner_replacements_terminal_summary_check
runner_replacements_terminal_summary_che.value: "runner_replacements"."terminal_summary" IS NULL OR (length(trim("runner_replacements"."terminal_summary")) BETWEEN 1 AND 240 AND "runner_replacements"."terminal_code" IS NOT NULL)

runner_replacements_terminal_evidence_ch.name: runner_replacements_terminal_evidence_check
runner_replacements_terminal_evidence_ch.value: ("runner_replacements"."terminal_code" IS NULL AND "runner_replacements"."terminal_summary" IS NULL) OR ("runner_replacements"."terminal_code" = 'replacement_budget_exhausted' AND "runner_replacements"."terminal_summary" = 'Automatic runner replacement budget was exhausted.') OR ("runner_replacements"."terminal_code" = 'target_provisioning_failed' AND "runner_replacements"."terminal_summary" = 'Replacement runner provisioning did not complete.') OR ("runner_replacements"."terminal_code" = 'target_validation_failed' AND "runner_replacements"."terminal_summary" = 'Replacement runner validation did not pass.') OR ("runner_replacements"."terminal_code" = 'source_fence_failed' AND "runner_replacements"."terminal_summary" = 'The source runner could not be fenced safely.') OR ("runner_replacements"."terminal_code" = 'reassignment_failed' AND "runner_replacements"."terminal_summary" = 'Agent reassignment did not complete safely.') OR ("runner_replacements"."terminal_code" = 'agent_convergence_failed' AND "runner_replacements"."terminal_summary" = 'Agents did not converge on the replacement runner.') OR ("runner_replacements"."terminal_code" = 'source_cleanup_failed' AND "runner_replacements"."terminal_summary" = 'The obsolete source runner could not be cleaned up safely.') OR ("runner_replacements"."terminal_code" = 'state_invalid' AND "runner_replacements"."terminal_summary" = 'The replacement workflow reached an invalid state.')

runner_replacements_terminal_state_check.name: runner_replacements_terminal_state_check
runner_replacements_terminal_state_check.value: ("runner_replacements"."state" = 'complete' AND "runner_replacements"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "runner_replacements"."failed_at" IS NULL AND "runner_replacements"."terminal_code" IS NULL AND "runner_replacements"."terminal_summary" IS NULL) OR ("runner_replacements"."state" = 'failed' AND "runner_replacements"."failed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "runner_replacements"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "runner_replacements"."terminal_code" IS NOT NULL AND "runner_replacements"."terminal_summary" IS NOT NULL) OR ("runner_replacements"."state" NOT IN ('complete', 'failed') AND "runner_replacements"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "runner_replacements"."failed_at" IS NULL AND "runner_replacements"."terminal_code" IS NULL AND "runner_replacements"."terminal_summary" IS NULL)

runner_replacements_active_work_check.name: runner_replacements_active_work_check
